name: golden-finger
description: Golden Finger for Codex — a local human-authorization relay for one-time consent and exact command execution, made for the Yes工程师 workflow.

interface.shortDescription: 人机授权中继：Yes工程师的一键确认与命令授权窗口
interface.longDescription: Codex金手指（Golden Finger for Codex）是为 Yes工程师准备的人机授权中继。它把 Codex 提议的单次命令或自然语言授权请求送到独立窗口，冻结并展示完请求；只有用户点击“同意本次”后才返回同意或执行精确命令，并由当前 Codex 回合持续拉取到终态。
capabilities: Non-click-through Codex-themed 60% acrylic window with fully opaque text
Latest-request foreground and optional sound alerts
Responsive minimum-size layout with a fixed approval bar
Compact live polling policy with an automatically derived total timeout
defaultPrompt: 使用 Codex金手指（人机授权中继），为当前唯一动作请求一次明确的人类确认；若仍为 pending/running，保持当前回合并严格按照响应中的下一次参数轮询到终态。
